title: Venezuela: Who is Maduro's wife Cilia Flores?
summary: Nicolas Maduro's wife - Celia Flores is not only Venezuela's first lady, but also a central figure in the country's political sphere. A member of parliament, she has served as attorney general and president of the National Assembly. She was a loyal supporter of Hugo Chavez - who then endorsed her husband's policies. Caroline Baum takes a closer look at her…
